verify:
select case
  when pg_catalog.to_regclass('private.product_notification_transitions') is null then
    pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.enroll_product_waitlist(uuid,text,boolean,text,text,text,uuid,text,jsonb)') is null
    and pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.configure_product_notification_email(boolean,jsonb)') is null
    and pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.materialize_product_notifications(integer)') is null
    and pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.request_product_notification_recovery(text,text,jsonb,boolean,uuid)') is null
    and pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.cancel_product_notification(text)') is null
    and pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.refresh_product_notification_email(uuid,uuid)') is null
  else
    exists (select from pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
      where c.conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('private.email_controls')
        and c.conname = 'retired_product_notification_controls'
        and c.convalidated and c.contype = 'c'
        and pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.conbin, c.conrelid) =
          '((purpose <> ALL (ARRAY[''product_availability''::text, ''product_waitlist_recovery''::text])) OR (NOT enabled))')
    and not exists (
      select from (values ('public.enroll_product_waitlist(uuid,text,boolean,text,text,text,uuid,text,jsonb)'),
      ('public.configure_product_notification_email(boolean,jsonb)'),
      ('public.materialize_product_notifications(integer)'),
      ('public.request_product_notification_recovery(text,text,jsonb,boolean,uuid)'),
      ('public.cancel_product_notification(text)'),
      ('public.refresh_product_notification_email(uuid,uuid)')) r(signature)
      cross join (values ('anon'), ('authenticated'), ('service_role')) a(role)
      where pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(r.signature) is null
        or pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(a.role, pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(r.signature), 'EXECUTE'))
    and exists (select from pg_catalog.pg_proc p
      where p.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('private.record_product_notification_transition(uuid,boolean,timestamptz,uuid)')
        and pg_catalog.regexp_replace(p.prosrc, '[[:space:]]+', '', 'g') =
          'beginreturn' || pg_catalog.chr(59) || 'end' || pg_catalog.chr(59))
    and 2 = (select count(*) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p
      where p.oid in (pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.claim_email_intents(text,uuid,integer)'),
                      pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.retry_email_delivery(uuid,timestamptz)'))
        and pg_catalog.strpos(p.prosrc, 'purpose not in (''product_availability'', ''product_waitlist_recovery'')') > 0)
end
and not exists (
  select from (values ('anon'), ('authenticated'), ('service_role')) a(role)
  where pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(a.role,
    pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.enroll_product_waitlist(uuid,text,boolean,text,text,text)'), 'EXECUTE')
)
and not exists (select from pg_catalog.pg_proc p cross join lateral pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a
  where p.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('private.retire_helix_product_notifications()')
    and a.grantee <> p.proowner)
as applied
